verdict.rationale: Docs describe a Logs page with per-request detail, search by request ID, filtering by model/provider/status, and export as CSV/JSON, plus a Requests section with summaries by project/API key and a Usage section with metrics — covering latency, tokens, cost, and routing detail. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that latency and cost are explicitly visible per logged request (only vendor docs cited), and no third-party corroboration of the observability UI.
